user.title: Connect to your XMEye device
user.description: Enter the address of your Xiongmai DVR, NVR or IP camera. The DVRIP service listens on TCP port 34567.

data_description.port: The DVRIP control port, not the web or RTSP port.
data_description.password: Leave empty if the device has no password set.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device on that address and port.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.

data_description.rtsp_template: Placeholders: {host}, {rtsp_port}, {username}, {password}, {channel} (1-based), {stream}. Only change this if live video does not work.
data_description.talk_channel: -1 sends audio to the device's own speaker output, which is what most firmware supports. Set a channel number only if your device routes talk per camera.
data_description.camera_speakers: Creates an extra speaker entity per camera so text-to-speech can target one camera instead of the whole recorder.
data_description.skip_empty_channels: Do not create entities for channels with no camera attached.
data_description.ptz_preset_count: How many numbered presets to offer per camera in the preset selector. Set to 0 to remove the selector, e.g. for recorders with no PTZ camera.

ptz.name: PTZ move
ptz.description: Moves a pan/tilt/zoom camera. Directional and zoom commands run continuously until stopped.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset number, used by the preset and tour commands.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to move before stopping automatically. Leave empty to keep moving until PTZ stop is called.

command.name: Command
command.description: The movement to stop; use the same command that started it.

time.name: Time
time.description: The time to set. Defaults to the Home Assistant host's current local time.

set_channel_title.name: Set channel name
set_channel_title.description: Renames a channel on the device itself.

search_recordings.name: Search recordings
search_recordings.description: Returns the recordings stored on the device for a channel and time range.

device_not_loaded.message: The XMEye device {device_id} is not currently loaded.
